texts.zh:
第四颗机械星球出现在[From.solar_system.GetName]星系。该星系的第六颗行星被有毒的烟雾所覆盖，但最近这颗行星却在短短的数天之内将自己的大气层全部排除干净了，然后行星地表发生了开裂，巨型机械工厂随之出现。

由人工智能控制的古代舰队从工厂的地下机库中一跃而出，随时准备对宇宙中的有机生物文明发动新一轮的绝罚。
texts.en:
A fourth Machine World is now active in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system. The sixth planet of the system, which was previously covered in toxic fumes, somehow expunged its dense atmosphere in a matter of days. When this process was over, the planet's surface parted to reveal an immense, planet-wide factory complex.

Ancient fleets of AI-controlled warships are now emerging from underground hangars to continue the crusade against the entirety of organic civilization.
